title: Rabbi Chanina bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 65b it is related that he, Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, and Rabbi Assi happened upon a certain inn. Rabbi Chanina bar Yosef said, "Let us rent," but Rabbi Assi said, "Let us not rent." Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said to him, "Let us rely on the words of the elder and rent." They came and asked Rabbi Yochanan, who said to them, "You did well to rent." Hyman refers to his Rabbi Chama bar Yosef entry, where he explains that Chama should be read here rather than Chanina.

notes.text: Hyman proposes Chama in place of Chanina and refers to his own Chama entry. Both forms remain visible.
